title: fumaria macrosepala var. atlantica
intro: Fumaria macrosepala var. atlantica, commonly known as a variety of Fumaria, is a plant species in the fumitory family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and have antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria macrosepala var. atlantica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and bioactive constituents, which are likely to include but not limited to: protoberberine alkaloids, and possibly anthraquinones.
